title: Bureau-Claim-Pfad revisionsgebunden und checkout-unabhängig machen
goal: Repariere den Grabowski–Bureau-Claim-Pfad so, dass eine bereite Augabe aus einem sauberen, aktuellen und schreibbaren Registry-Ausgangspunkt mit vollständigen Fähigkeiten und explizit aktuellem Repository-Basiscommit atomar geclaimt werden kann, ohne fremde schmutzige Checkouts zu verändern. Gib konkrete, strukturierte Ablehnungsgründe statt des pauschalen claim-intent-not-ready zurück.

acceptance.assertion: The claim adapter uses a clean, current, explicitly revision-bound Registry source and does not require or mutate a foreign dirty Bureau main checkout.
All task-required capabilities are preserved through candidate selection, claim intent and coordinated execution; missing capabilities produce an exact structured rejection.
A new implementation workspace is bound to an explicitly approved current remote repository commit and fails closed when the local source head is stale or ambiguous.
Receipt drift reports the exact blocking task, receipt and revision mismatch; unrelated task drift does not silently collapse into claim-intent-not-ready without a documented global-policy reason.
Required Registry, repository and workspace leases can be acquired and released through a healthy typed contract without bypassing foreign ownership.

Regression tests cover dirty shared Registry checkout, canonical read-only snapshot, stale repository base, missing capabilities, foreign receipt drift, healthy claim creation and zero-effect rejection readback.

After the repair, an identical dry-run or bounded claim attempt for REPOGROUND-LEGACY-RECONCILIATION-V1-T004 either creates an owner-bound run on the current RepoGround head or returns one precise remaining blocker with no partial effects.

reviewed_plan.basis: Live reproductions on Grabowski runtime 476c06bad629722b03768b0684d25897405b7cfd: dirty explicit Registry root blocks, canonical snapshot is read-only, and proposal/claim paths fail before effects.
